name: Tmux-IDE
description: An open-source, agent-first terminal IDE built on tmux, designed as a workspace optimized for AI coding agents rather than humans. It provides a purpose-built terminal environment for orchestrating Claude agent teams with declarative YAML configuration.
community_quotes: AI coding agents are trapped in tools built for humans
Terminal-first makes a lot of sense for anything that runs on remote servers
A workspace for AI agents that are typically 'trapped in tools built for humans'
Most surprising was that something this lightweight made such a big impact on my productivity
Having persistent Claude teams on my remote machines that I can always access no matter what

name: LucidShark
description: A local-first, open-source CLI tool that acts as a quality and security pipeline for AI coding agents. It orchestrates common quality checks including linting, type checking, tests, security scans, and coverage analysis in a feedback loop with AI coding workflows.
community_quotes: Local-first, open-source CLI tool that acts as a quality & security pipeline
Can be used to increase confidence in AI-generated code
Orchestrates common quality checks including linting, type checking, tests, security scans, and coverage
Works in a feedback loop: AI writes code → LucidShark checks → AI fixes → repeat
